claims.claim: A strong neatly used kids bicycle
claims.evidence: Witness report confirms it is a bicycle with front suspension, blue seat, and indoor condition, but does not confirm it is specifically a kids size or that it is 'strong' (no functional test shown).

risks.risk: Unclear whether it is truly a kids-size bike (wheel/frame size not readable), which affects fit and resale value in Oyo.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing wheel size marking (e.g., 16/18/20/24) and/or frame size label, plus a side view with the full frame visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used bicycle with unknown size/fit.

risks.risk: Gear system not confirmed (single-speed vs multi-gear), which changes maintenance needs and buyer demand.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drivetrain and shifters/derailleurs (rear cassette/freewheel area and shifter near handlebars).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case for complexity/unknown drivetrain condition.

risks.risk: Tire condition unknown (tread depth, cracks, punctures, whether tires hold air).
risks.proof: Close-up of both tires and a short clip showing the bike being rolled; also a shot of valve stems and any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing tire check/replacement risk.

risks.risk: Brakes condition unknown (pad/shoe wear, cable condition, braking performance).
risks.proof: Video clip of braking: rider squeezes brakes and bike stops smoothly; plus close-ups of brake pads/shoes and cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'brakes may need service' (worst-case wear).

risks.risk: Wheel/rim and bearing condition unknown (alignment, dents, bearing play).
risks.proof: Clip showing wheels spun and a close-up of rims for dents; also a shot of the hub area for play.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'wheel service possible' due to unknown alignment/bearings.

risks.risk: Frame condition unknown (rust, cracks, dents) and whether any parts are missing/replaced.
risks.proof: Full-frame walkaround photos (both sides) with good lighting, focusing on joints, chainstay, seat tube, and fork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'unknown frame condition' with potential repairs.

risks.proof: Photos of included accessories and a short clip showing headlight turns on (and any other lights).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming accessories are included or working.

proof_requests: Clear photo showing wheel size (e.g., 16/18/20/24) and full frame size/side profile.
Close-up of drivetrain: rear cassette/freewheel, chain, and whether there is a derailleur/shifter.
Close-up photos of tires (both sides) and a quick clip rolling the bike to check for wobble.
Video of braking performance plus close-ups of brake pads/shoes and brake cables.
Photos of rims/hubs and a clip spinning wheels to check for wobble or bearing noise.
Full walkaround photos of the frame and fork joints to check for cracks/rust/dents.
Photos/clip confirming what accessories are included and whether the headlight works.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a bicycle with specific visible features (front suspension, fenders, chain guard, rear rack, headlight), so it can be priced at a worst-case used-bike level while treating size/condition/function details as unknown until proven.
